business_summary: Hangzhou Freely Communication Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the artificial intelligence driven omni-channel digital marketing, low-altitude economy, and digital infrastructure business in China. The company offers creative content creation, customized placement strategies, real-time data analysis, and operational optimization. It also offers full-domain digital marketing services to telecommunications operators and other entities, including communication network construction and maintenance services, communication product sales and operation, indoor distribution system and base station installation engineering services, integrated access services, and antenna engineering services. In addition, the company engages in research and development of avionics and flight control systems for eVTOL and medium and large UAVs. Further, it provides 5G new infrastructure-related and digital transformation services, including communication network construction and maintenance services to government, enterprise, and large industry sectors. Additionally, the company offers professional and information technology consulting services, application software development, technology promotion and application services, cross-border internet, wholesale and retail services, information transmission, software and information technology services, and serves telecom operators. Hangzhou Freely Communication Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
